historical_predictor: Euclidean magnitude of four (21ka minus 0BP) local climatic displacements, each standardized by the species-balanced training-only SD of the corresponding 0BP climate band; then standardized for training-only model fit.
fit: weighted logistic regression with C=2.0, lbfgs max_iter=150 tolerance=1e-5. All training species sum to equal total weight; cases and surveyed backgrounds each receive half of species weight. No species/random-intercept leakage into heldout species.
evaluation: Species-mean held-out AUC improvement of augmented versus baseline; fixed species split 44/36; species cluster bootstrap 98.33% two-sided interval.

synthetic_generating_process.case_count_conditioning: Generate exactly the observed frozen number of case-grid records per species using Gumbel top-K weighted by synthetic baseline + history + spatial field. The real case/background response labels are NEVER used as regression responses during synthetic calibration.
synthetic_generating_process.site_level_correlation: 3 random-direction spatial Fourier cosine waves per species and replicate, independent species-level coefficients; fixed feature geometry; does not exactly reproduce line-generating processes.

positional_uncertainty: Full 50km jittered-break location sensitivity is a SEPARATE required gate before empirical genetic response opening. Synthetic null/positive calibration does not discharge this requirement.
source_rights: All licensed IUCN-derived range points and UNEP raw sources remain ephemeral in GitHub Actions; upload only aggregate QA and world calibration counts and no raw matrices.
